;Health and environment
*A [[Eurasian beaver|beaver]] is seen in Northern [[Italy]] on camera, a species that has not been seen in the country since [[1471]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/beavers-italy-return-500-years-1.4938739 (CBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Death of Grace Millane]]
**The body of missing tourist Grace Millane is found outside of [[Auckland]], [[New Zealand]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-essex-46502649 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2018 Armenian parliamentary election]]
**[[Armenia]]n citizens vote in the country's first ever [[snap election]] and the first one since the [[2018 Armenian revolution|Velvet Revolution]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/armenia-holds-snap-election-for-parliament/4692876.html (VOA)]

;Sports
*[[2018 UK Championship]]
**[[Ronnie O'Sullivan]] wins a record seventh [[UK Championship]] [[snooker]] title after defeating [[Mark Allen (snooker player)|Mark Allen]] 10–6 in the final at the [[Barbican Centre, York]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/snooker/46501187 (BBC)]
*[[2018 NFL season]]
**In [[American football]], [[Larry Fitzgerald]] of the [[Arizona Cardinals]] passes [[Jerry Rice]] to become the all-time receptions leader with one team. [https://touchdownwire.usatoday.com/2018/12/09/larry-fitzgerald-passes-jerry-rice-for-most-receptions-with-one-team/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[2018 Copa Libertadores]]
**In international [[association football|football]], [[Club Atlético River Plate|River Plate]] wins the [[Copa Libertadores]] by beating [[Boca Juniors]] 3–1 in [[Overtime (sports)|extra-time]] ([[aggregate score]] 5–3). The final is played at the [[Santiago Bernabéu Stadium|Bernabéu stadium]] in [[Madrid]]. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/46500549 (BBC)]
* [[2019 Baseball Hall of Fame balloting]]
** In [[Major League Baseball]], the [[National Baseball Hall of Fame and Museum|Hall of Fame]] announces the first members of its 2019 induction class, with [[Harold Baines]] and [[Lee Smith (baseball)|Lee Smith]] voted in by [[Veterans Committee|one of four special committees]]. They, along with any players elected by the [[Baseball Writers' Association of America]] in January 2019, will be formally inducted at the Hall's facility in [[Cooperstown, New York]] on July 21, 2019. [http://www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/id/25495724/chicago-legends-harold-baines-lee-smith-make-hall-fame (AP via ESPN)]
